entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a piece of garbage. The pulse tracker is completely inaccurate and I want my money back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the features?
It's a fault! It's a huge fault! It says my heart rate is 150 when I'm sitting on the couch. This thing is dangerous. I don't have time for troubleshooting this junk. I just want my money back.

I understand your frustration, and accuracy is incredibly important to us. For a defect claim like this, the standard procedure is to connect you with our technical support team. They can run a remote diagnostic and verify the issue for a warranty claim.

Absolutely not! I am not spending another minute on this. I've already wasted enough time. It's garbage. I want a refund. Are you going to process a refund or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your Twitter feed?
Okay, sir, I understand you don't wish to speak with technical support. Let me see what I can do. Can you please confirm the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's angrycustomer@email.com. Just get it done.

Thank you. One moment while I pull up your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. It was delivered on December 15th, 2025, which was 27 days ago. Let me just check our current return policy. Please hold.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked our knowledge base, and it states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 27, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Finally. See? That wasn't so hard. Yes, process the full refund.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. I expect to see that email in the next two minutes.
It has already been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I apologize again for the inconvenience.
